purpose: Make inherited300s stability criterion executable and unambiguous, retaining same conservative prior rule. V1 observer30s samples were metadata-only, not eligible for25/300s test.

rule.timestamps: timezone-aware, strictly increasing; any malformed complete line refuses; only a final unterminated line may be ignored
rule.per_launch: Also fresh statvfs >=12.2e9+projected growth; reread monitor at final spawn decision
rule.scope: Each>=3600s job and any scientifically continuous workload expected>=3600s even if re-chunked. No stale sample and no automatic retries after a STOP.
